newsitem.title: USA: Iomega Corp awards Euro RSCG with account.
newsitem.headline: Iomega Corp awards Euro RSCG with account.

text.p: Iomega Corp said on Monday that it had awarded an account to Euro RSCG to handle its global advertising efforts, making the New York and Paris-based advertising agency one of Iomega's three marketing partners worldwide.

"Strong global partnerships, such as our alliance with Euro RSCG, enable us to extend our messaging as well as to ensure continuity and consistency with our brand worldwide," said Timothy Hill, vice president of sales and marketing at Iomega.
Iomega did not specify how much the account was worth.
Iomega Corp provides personal computer storage solutions for use in homes, businesses, government and education.
